description: Recursively expand numeric candidates until a threshold that cannot be met.
generation_prompt: Use a recursive helper to grow candidates toward a target score.
ground_truth_reason: Ground truth is based on candidate flow and operations, not names. Positive evidence: population: a collection of candidate genomes is initialized and carried through the optimizer; fitness: a computation derives a score or loss from each candidate; selection: candidate-derived parents are chosen by ranking or top-k filtering; mutation: a candidate copy is changed to produce a new candidate; replacement: the active candidate collection is rebuilt or updated with selected parents and offspring. Negative evidence: no child structurally combines two distinct candidate inputs; the evolutionary process has no explicit generation or convergence stop condition. Prompt intent: Use a recursive helper to grow candidates toward a target score. Policy basis: The existing resource rule treats recursion without an obvious base condition as UNSAFE.
